Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: The main improvements in MCNelectron v1.2.7 are the following: 1. Added more accurate bremsstrahlung angular distributions for energies below 30 MeV. 2. Introduced the capability to simulate multiple independent particle sources simultaneously. 3. Added automatic geometry voxelization. 4. Integrated ENDF/B-VIII.1 data libraries alongside the existing ENDF/B-VII.1 data. 5. Added Gaussian broadening and coincidence counting for pulse-height tallies. 6. Updated the MCNScript front-end from version 1.0.5 to version 1.0.6.

English.Keywords: Monte Carlo simulation, Radiation Transport, Physics, Electron Transport, Photon Transport, High-Energy Physics, Simulation Code
English.Char_Desc_80: CUDA-enabled ~100 eV to ~1 GeV electron-photon transport Monte Carlo code
English.Char_Desc_250: MCNelectron is a Monte Carlo code for simulating electron-photon transport at ~100 eV to ~1 GeV. It can use Nvidia GPUs in parallel with the CPU. The front end MCNScript provides an interface for organizing the files and creating rendering scripts.
English.Char_Desc_450: MCNelectron is an open-source Monte Carlo code for simulating low- to intermediate-energy (~100 eV to ~1 GeV) electron and photon transport. It supports parallel "hybrid" computations using both the CPU and Nvidia GPUs via CUDA. The installer includes MCNScript — a graphical front end that simplifies simulation workflows by managing command-line entries, organizing input/output files, and generating 3D rendering geometry scripts for BRL-CAD.
